title: Vending machine
prompt: Create a vending machine furniture (with model models/vending_machine.json) that opens the existing bench:shop GUI when right-clicked.

replay.note: The dry run reports MTR-0009 for texture 'block/vending_machine', a default the furniture scaffold writes beside a model that resolves to nothing in the pack (benchmark S18). The list is otherwise accepted: the model and bench:shop GUI reference resolve, and the click rule on furnitures/vending_machine.yml compiles.
